FROM price_request_merges AS prm LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.id = prm.created_by LEFT JOIN price_request_merge_details AS prmd ON prmd.price_request_merge_id = prm.id LEFT JOIN price_requests AS pr ON pr.id = prmd.price_request_id LEFT JOIN price_request_vendors AS prv ON prv.id = pr.price_request_vendor_id LEFT JOIN price_request_mobiles AS prmbl ON prmbl.price_request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN delivery_status AS ds ON ds.id = pr.delivery_status_id

AND (pr.created_by LIKE CONCAT(#{filter.createdBy}))
AND pr.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE cgroup_id = #{filter.organizationGroupId})
AND (pr.model LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR pr.pgroup_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR pr.request_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%"))
